name: Hexagonal architecture enforcement (ArchUnit)
note: ArchUnit rules enforced at L2 for Java hexagonal archetype; cross-stack architecture rules vary by paradigm

name: Package dependency rules (no domain→infra leakage)
note: Hexagonal layering: domain must not import infrastructure packages

name: Interface + implementation separation rule
note: Port/adapter pattern: repository interfaces in domain, implementations in infrastructure

name: No Spring annotations in domain layer
note: Java/Spring-specific: domain classes must not use @Component, @Service, @Repository etc.

name: @Async annotation only in service layer
note: Java/Spring-specific: async methods must be in application/service layer, not domain

name: Bean Validation constraints in domain entities only
note: Java/Spring: validation annotations (@NotNull, @Size etc.) confined to domain entities

name: No circular dependencies between modules
note: Enforced by madge (TS) / ArchUnit (Java) / cargo check (Rust)

name: Tamper-evident audit log insert-only rule (R-audit-insert-only)
note: Tamper-evident audit log: append-only pattern enforced by architecture rule R-audit-insert-only

name: Static analysis: linting (checkstyle/eslint/ruff/golangci-lint/clippy)
note: L1 gate enforces per-stack linter with zero-warning policy

name: Static analysis: formatting (spotless/prettier/black/gofmt/rustfmt)
note: Format check enforced at L1 gate

name: PMD / Semgrep rules (complexity, security anti-patterns)
note: PMD Java-specific; Semgrep applicable cross-stack but not yet enforced

name: SpotBugs / null-safety analysis
note: SpotBugs Java-specific; TypeScript has strict null checks; Rust/Go enforce at compiler level

name: Cyclomatic complexity gate
note: Complexity rules in golangci-lint/ruff/eslint; Java via PMD; threshold enforcement varies by stack

name: Dead code detection
note: knip (TS), golangci-lint deadcode (Go), cargo unused (Rust); Java via PMD

name: Code duplication ratchet (jscpd / equivalent)
note: jscpd wired for TS at L2 gate; Java uses PMD CPD; other stacks partial

name: Style token enforcement (design tokens / style guide)
note: CSS/styling tokens enforced for frontend stacks; backend services use code style only

name: Unit test framework wired (JUnit5/Vitest/pytest/go test/cargo test)
note: Each stack has a canonical unit test runner wired into L1 gate

name: Code coverage gate (JaCoCo/V8/coverage.py/go cover/cargo-tarpaulin)
note: Coverage threshold enforced at L2; arbiter default 85% lines, kit baseline 80%

name: Coverage trend ratchet (no regression allowed)
note: Coverage baseline ratchet prevents regressions across PRs

name: Mutation testing (pitest/stryker/mutmut/go-mutesting/cargo-mutants)
note: INV-29 enforces mutation score threshold; tooling wired per stack at L3

name: Test isolation — no shared mutable state between tests
note: Enforced by test framework config (vitest pool isolation, JUnit @DirtiesContext)

name: Test naming convention enforced
note: check-test-naming.mjs enforces naming contract at L1

name: Test TDD evidence captured (W4 protocol)
note: W4 TDD evidence under .arbiter/evidence/tdd/; enforced by check-tdd-evidence.mjs at L2

name: Fast test profile (L1 unit only, <2 min)
note: L1 gate runs unit tests only; integration tests excluded via vitest/gradle profile

name: Extended test profile (L2: unit + integration)
note: L2 gate runs full test suite including integration tests

name: Nightly/weekly test profile (L3: full suite + mutation + security)
note: T4/T5 nightly+weekly CI tiers run mutation, DAST, fuzz, full security scans

name: Integration tests (Spring IT / testcontainers / real-project fixtures)
note: Real-project fixture tests run per stack; integration tests in L2 profile

name: Contract tests (Spring Cloud Contract / Pact)
note: Contract testing enforced at L2 for service APIs; coverage varies by stack

name: BDD / behavioural tests (Cucumber / pytest-bdd / godog)
note: BDD tooling available cross-stack; enforcement level varies by archetype

name: Architectural tests (ArchUnit / structure rules)
note: Architecture rule tests wired for hexagonal archetype; other archetypes use static analysis

name: Fuzz testing (Jazzer / go-fuzz / cargo-fuzz)
note: Fuzz testing supported at L3 nightly tier; tooling coverage varies by stack

name: Property-based testing (QuickCheck / Hypothesis / proptest)
note: Property-based testing not yet wired into arbiter gate; follow-up opportunity

name: Snapshot / golden-file tests
note: Snapshot tests used in arbiter self-tests (api-snapshot.mjs); pattern available cross-stack

name: Multi-tier CI pipeline (fast → extended → release → nightly → weekly)
note: 6-tier CI model (T0..T5) enforced by workflow runner checks and ci-alignment gate

name: PR fast-feedback gate (<5 min, L1 checks only)
note: T1 (check subcommand) completes in ~2 min; T2 (gate) in ~10 min

name: Release pipeline (tag-triggered, artifact signing)
note: Release workflow signs artifacts with cosign; SLSA provenance via attest-build-provenance

name: Nightly extended checks (mutation, DAST, performance baseline)
note: T4 nightly tier runs mutation + DAST + fuzz; heartbeat monitor keeps pipeline honest

name: Weekly audit pipeline (dependency audit, license scan, SBOM refresh)
note: T5 weekly tier runs npm audit, license scan, SBOM refresh, gitleaks full scan

name: CI runner label SSOT (no hardcoded runner strings)
note: INV-13 enforces CI_BUILD_RUNNER_LABEL repo variable as SSOT; check-workflow-runners.mjs gates this

name: Artifact provenance (SLSA / sigstore)
note: SLSA provenance generated via actions/attest-build-provenance for all release artifacts

name: E2E API tests (RestAssured / Playwright / pytest-playwright)
note: E2E tests wired at L3 nightly tier; Playwright for browser stacks, RestAssured for Java APIs

name: Performance / load testing baseline (k6 / Locust / Gatling)
note: Performance testing tooling not yet generated by arbiter; follow-up opportunity

name: DAST scan (OWASP ZAP / Nuclei)
note: DAST wired at T4 nightly tier; ZAP scan against running service

name: Auth flow E2E (Keycloak-compatible IdP integration test)
note: Auth E2E testing against a Keycloak-compatible IdP; not yet generated by arbiter

name: Format validation script (check-format.sh equivalent)
note: Format check is part of L1 gate (prettier/spotless/black/gofmt/rustfmt)

name: SPDX license header check
note: check-spdx-headers.mjs enforces Apache-2.0 SPDX headers at L1

name: Orphan TODO check (no bare TODOs without task IDs)
note: check-no-orphan-todo.mjs gates orphan TODOs at L1; post-edit hook enforces inline

name: Placeholder check (no template placeholders committed)
note: check-no-placeholders.mjs gates placeholder patterns at L1

name: Dead link / doc link integrity check
note: check-doc-links.mjs validates internal doc links at L1 gate

name: Bloat ratchet (bundle size / generated artifact size)
note: check-bloat-ratchet.mjs enforces size baseline at L1; refuses shrink without --allow-shrink

name: Debt ratchet (tech-debt score gate)
note: debt-report.mjs --gate enforced at L2; debt score cannot increase without explicit override

name: Self-dogfood check (arbiter validates itself)
note: INV-75/76: check-arbiter-self-dogfood.mjs + check-self-dogfood.mjs both run at L1

name: API snapshot test (no unintended public surface changes)
note: check-api-snapshot.mjs gates API surface at L1; changes require explicit snapshot update

name: Circular dependency detection
note: madge --circular at L1 gate; post-edit hook checks after every TS/JS edit

name: Secret scanning (Gitleaks)
note: Gitleaks on staged files (pre-commit hook) + full repo scan at L2 gate

name: Dependency audit (npm audit / OWASP dependency-check / cargo audit)
note: npm audit at L2 gate; cargo audit / pip-audit supported; blocks on HIGH+ severity

name: Container image scan (Trivy)
note: Trivy container scan at T5 weekly tier; generated for services with Dockerfile

name: License scan (FOSSA / ORT / licensee)
note: License scan at T5 weekly tier; blocks on GPL/AGPL in permissively-licensed services

name: Commit message format enforced (commitlint)
note: commitlint wired at L1 gate + post-commit hook checks format after every commit

name: Branch naming convention enforced
note: task/* branch convention enforced by execution protocol; pre-commit guard via AGENTS.md

name: PR template (description, test plan, checklist)
note: .github/pull_request_template.md generated for target projects

name: Issue templates (bug, feature, tech-debt)
note: GitHub issue templates generated for target projects

name: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md governance document
note: AGENTS.md generated as AAIF-standard governance doc for all arbiter-managed projects

name: CI/CD developer reference card
note: CI developer reference template provided (TPL_cicd-developer-reference); generator deferred to Phase D

name: Architecture decision records (ADRs)
note: docs/SYSTEM/DECISIONS.md generated and maintained as ADR log for arbiter-managed projects

name: API / OpenAPI specification
note: OpenAPI spec generation not yet in arbiter scope; follow-up opportunity

name: Runbook (operational playbook for oncall)
note: Operational runbook template not yet generated; follow-up opportunity

name: Knowledge map (cross-repo canonical paths and signal sources)
note: check-knowledge-map.mjs enforces canonical signal sources at L1; arbiter self-documents paths

name: Runtime version SSOT (node version pinned, .nvmrc aligned)
note: check-node-version-ssot.mjs enforces single source of truth for node version at L1

name: Environment variable safety (.env.example only, no real .env committed)
note: Gitleaks catches .env commits; arbiter generates only .env.*.example templates

name: Feature flag / experiment registry (no undocumented flags)
note: src/experimental/registry.ts enforces known-experiment guard; unknown flag = exit 1

name: Multi-environment config (dev/staging/prod parity)
note: Multi-env config templates not yet generated by arbiter; follow-up opportunity

name: Tamper-evident audit log table DDL (security-critical operations)
note: Tamper-evident audit log for security-critical operations; DDL with insert-only grants and created_at immutability

name: Audit trigger presence (DB-level audit trigger enforced)
note: Database trigger enforces audit log population for security-critical write operations

name: Audit log service interface (AuditEventService / append-only repository pattern)
note: Append-only repository pattern for audit events; no update/delete operations permitted in service layer

name: Accessibility (a11y) audit (Axe / Lighthouse / pa11y)
note: a11y auditing for frontend archetypes; INV-61 enforces a11y gate when frontend present
